sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite their recent loss, Sandbach remain the division leaders and will be heavy favorites against the struggling visitors who sit bottom with just 4 points and a run of five losses in their last six. They then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October at 15:00, another fixture against a side in poor form—Nomads are second-bottom with 7 points and winless in their last four outings.
divisionWide: In the title race, second-placed Stafford Town face Dawley Town away on 3 October before hosting struggling Wednesfield Community on 10 October; they'll be targeting wins to keep pace with Sandbach. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Market Drayton Town (who are on just one win in five) on 3 October. Fourth-ranked Wolverhampton Casuals also play on 3 October, traveling to Wednesfield Community in a midweek clash on 7 October before hosting them again on the weekend—an unusual scheduling quirk. Bilston Town (5th) face Foley Meir at home on 3 October and host Crewe on 10 October, while Eccleshall (5th) welcome AFC Bridgnorth. Mid-table contenders Barnton visit Shawbury United on 10 October, and New Mills travel to Telford Town on the same day. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Sandbach on 10 October after visiting Sandbach on 3 October, while Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social on 3 October and face Market Drayton on 10 October. Other matches include Crewe at home to Allscott Heath (3 Oct), Shawbury hosting Barnton on 3 October before visiting Alsager on 10 October, and Brereton facing Wednesfield Community on 7 October as a midweek fixture before hosting Allscott Heath on 10 October.
